reason: Both accept our staff's stock numbers and ask for a 3-fish limit or shorter season, but B gives us something we rarely get from charter captains: trip logs since 2016 and a catch-reporting app trial, plus a candid admission that he can't say every boat would close. A is tighter but offers nothing in return and stretches with "charter boats land the least flounder," which the 9% and 80% figures alone don't establish.
